title: Last BG value not shown on Main Screen and Widget
body:
This may be user error (me), or an incompatibility issue.
**Background:** 
Latest xDrip version, connected to Patched Dexcom G6 App via 640G/Eversource Option.
Works great except for:

**Problem:**
The current BG Level and Arrow, is missing from both the main display and the widget. I am running on a brand new Samsung S21 Ultra. See the two pics below.
Any help would be greatly appreciated. This app is absolutely phenomenal.

![2021-01-31_14-12-36](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/2557753/106395329-bae6cc80-63cf-11eb-8bb5-c840eb244aff.jpg)
![2021-01-31_14-21-22](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/2557753/106395331-bde1bd00-63cf-11eb-84b3-38ba955ef225.jpg)

comments.body:
You did not provide your environment information which was requested with the bug report template. Please add the missing information, especially Android and xDrip version.

BTW: In two weeks, nobody knows what the "latest xDrip version" is.

Sorry. Here you go...

Android 11, Samsung One UI version: 3.1
xDrip+ version: e14bae1-2020.07.13.
Please can you try the latest nightly?
@skavan Please can you provide your screen resolution? Please also try to lower the resolution to WGHD (2560x1440) or even FHD (1920x1080) or corresponding values your phone provides.

My 3 available screen resolutions are:
1. WQHD+: 3200 x 1440
2. FHD+ : 2400 x 1080
3. HD+ 1600 x 720

It was using #2, but I have tried the other two settings. Unfortunately no change.
Happy to keep trying stuff.

s.

Don't know if it's related, but I also get a "Please start Sensor for best results" Toast, every so often.
I'm not connected to the sensor via xdrip though.
Do you see any errors in the log? What happens if you enable graphical trend arrows (long-press on the blood icon or xDrip+ at the top)?

Tried all the settings like graphical trend arrow.
In logs, I see the following RED item and a couple of other ones....pasted below.

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/2557753/106398565-85e37580-63e1-11eb-8e24-b27ac3706ecb.png)

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/2557753/106398592-add2d900-63e1-11eb-978c-3fdcdf647017.png)

Oh wow...it's started working!
Here's what I did:
I just went and turned the sensor on. Even though there isn't one!

Of course, before I did this, it said Start Sensor, not stop sensor!

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/2557753/106398687-584afc00-63e2-11eb-8fc7-6bd946a2b160.png)

Good to know. I'll raise another issue for this or change the title.

Regarding to the red error in the logs: Please disable "Automatic Crash Reporting".

Thanks. p.s. would be good to set a BG color for widget. It's transparent, which on a light background makes it tough to read. I'm also totally stuck on how to enter carbs/get a treatment dialog - like this from your screen shots...
I should probably start a new issue. It's a quite game changing piece of software BTW.

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/2557753/106398856-3c942580-63e3-11eb-857d-71e1040cf752.png)
Please ask at the support channels, first!
Can we close this issue please?
